description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'HolidayAPITest' for testing the 'HolidayAPI' endpoints related to holiday management in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It includes tests for CRUD operations, validation rules, and data retrieval, utilizing mock objects and fixtures.

classes.name: HolidayAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for the HolidayAPI class, covering methods for getting, creating, updating, and deleting holiday data, along with validation rules.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixtures from YAML file into the database for testing.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single holiday by ID and verifies the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the rules for fetching one holiday.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing holiday record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the rules for updating a holiday.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a holiday by ID.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the rules for deleting holidays.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new holiday and verifies the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the rules for creating a holiday.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of holidays with filters and verifies the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the rules for fetching all holidays.
